$comment: Branch-profile schema (a JSON Schema subset, checked by engine/schema_check.py with the standard library). In schema now: the keys slice 1 reads, plus the per-machine slot. Later groups are declared optional and must stay empty until a branch needs them; see engine/KEYS.md. MW-002 adds vcs (required), ids.card_prefix and gates.<name>.budget_seconds. MW-003 adds cards, register, locks.targets, paths, test_roots, test_env, knowledge.files, questions.files; items leaves the schema (D-8). MW-004 adds agents.cap_minutes. MW-006 adds the commit group (junk, data_patterns, max_file_kb).

vcs.description: git is optional: with none every git step is off (R8); no default

root.description: bundle folder, relative to the repository top, at any depth

items.description: later (D-8): the card layout is fixed in the engine (<bundle.root>/cards/<ID>-<slug>/CARD.md and REGISTER.md beside it) until a second layout exists

locks.description: lock targets beside the built-in ones; later: names, open files, record, marker

targets.description: a name and repo paths or globs; closed unless the owner's `mkway lock open <name>` opened it

open_by_default.description: open until the owner's `mkway lock close <name>` writes a marker; profile targets only, never a built-in name (MW-010)

lock_gate.description: the git form reader of the lock gate (MW-031); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

git_builtins_extra.description: git built-in command names added to the engine list (`lock_gate.git_builtins` in defaults.json); `mkway check` shows the ones this git has and the list lacks as info; default none

gates.description: gate name (engine/manifest.json gate) -> switch; a mode is a nested object with its own switch

budget_seconds.description: seconds a gate may take; the dispatcher passes it in ctx and logs over-budget

min_calls.description: read under gates.trip only (MW-012): the calls in 24 hours a form gate needs before it can trip; default 20

share.description: read under gates.trip only (MW-012): the refusal share above which a form gate trips into watch; default 0.34

additionalProperties.description: a gate switch: on, an optional budget, and nested modes

card_prefix.description: the card id prefix of `mkway card new`; no default; mkway install writes CARD into the starter profile

shared_dir.description: MW-026: opt-in. An absolute folder for the files that cross worktrees (leads.json, inbox/, sessions.jsonl, pings.jsonl, dead-letter.jsonl, lock markers). Unset: they live in the root's own state folder

outbox.description: the outbox check (MW-019): files made for someone outside the session count as checked only with a check file beside them

dir.description: the folder of the files made for someone outside the session (the owner, a customer); no default: with no folder there is no outbox

checkers.description: the agent types that may sign a check; no default: with none, no check is valid

id_patterns_file.description: a task-supplied file of regexes, one per line, that a checked text must not match; the engine ships none

user.description: per-machine slot (optional; a missing value is reported, never required)

cap_minutes.description: minutes a helper agent may run; the start block lists each agent of the session over it or with no end row; default 30 (MW-004)

owner_moves.description: statuses only the owner may set; default ["open","closed"]; [] is the light mode

approver.description: who closes a card for a session: owner-only (default), or orderer (MW-011: the session that ordered the card, when it is not the holder and the card's tests pass); MW-008 adds other-session

columns.description: the register's column names for id, title, status, paths, folder, and optionally a sixth for who ordered the card (MW-011); default Id, Title, Status, Paths, Folder, Ordered by

docs.description: a commit holding only these paths runs no tests; default <bundle.root>/cards/**, <bundle.root>/ledger/**, *.md

exempt.description: paths the subtask gate always allows; default none

test_roots.description: the test folders run at commit; default ["tests"]

test_env.description: environment variable names passed to the commit's test run, beside ENGINE_TERMS_FILE

files.description: question files: a write to one needs a search record, like AskUserQuestion

leads.description: the lead role (MW-017); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

escalate_hours.description: hours a notice may stay unacked before the owner sees it in `mkway leads` and in the start block of a session that is no lead; default 4 (MW-017)

max_cards.description: cards (not closed) one lead may have ordered before `mkway leads` prints a warning line, never a refusal; default 5 (MW-017)

messaging.description: messages between sessions (MW-018); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

duplicate_window_hours.description: hours inside which the same body to a second recipient is refused `message-duplicate`; default 1 (MW-018)

dead_hours.description: hours after which a session last seen is dead: a send to it goes to the dead letter; default 12 (MW-018)

ack_reminder_minutes.description: minutes an order may stay unacked before a Stop gets a reminder line, never a block; default 30 (MW-018)

notify.description: the owner's notification of a new ask (MW-014); the engine ships no channel

command.description: a command line the engine runs after an ask file is written, with {file} (the ask file) and {line} (the question, the default, the deadline) filled in; no shell reads it; 10 seconds at most; default none: nothing runs

owner_ask.description: the questions-to-the-owner gate (MW-007); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

dir.description: the folder of the ask files (<name>_ask.md), relative to the repository top; default <bundle.root>/asks

markers.description: a final reply with a line that starts with one of these strings is an ask; default ["Request:"]

sources.description: the source names of the quote lines (> <source>: <verbatim>) and of the count lines (<source>: N contradictions); default ["review"]

max_open.description: how many asks with status open one session may have at a time (MW-014); default 1

tool_allowed.description: true lets a session use the pop-up question tool (AskUserQuestion); default false: it is refused and the file route is named (MW-014)

commit.description: the commit gate (MW-006); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

junk.description: patterns of files a commit never holds (a name or glob at any depth; a trailing / is a folder); default __pycache__/, *.pyc, .pytest_cache/, .pytest_tmp/, *.log, *.tmp, *.orig, *.rej, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db

data_patterns.description: patterns of data files a commit never holds, by extension; default *.csv, *.tsv, *.xlsx, *.xls, *.parquet, *.db, *.sqlite, *.sqlite3, *.bak, *.dump

max_file_kb.description: the largest file, in KB, a commit may hold; default 1024

message_prefix.description: the start of the install commit message, for example #10536 (MW-035); no spaces or shell characters; default none

deliverables.description: deliverables built from tested code and compared with a named base (MW-020)

paths.description: globs of the result files made for others; may overlap `outbox.dir`; default none

require_base.description: globs of the paths whose check file must name a delivered base (`base: <sha8>`); default none

rules.description: rule cards paired with tests (MW-021); the check is on only when both keys are set

cards.description: globs of the rule-card files; the id is read from the file name by the form `ids.rule_card`; default none

test_for.description: the test path of a card, with `{id}` for the card id, e.g. tests/rules/{id}/test_{id}.py; default none

tests.description: the commit gate's test run (MW-005); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

command.description: the whole command line of the run, roots included, started in the exported staged tree; its first word is the profile's Python; default python -m pytest -q followed by the test_roots

delete.description: the delete gate (MW-009); every key has a default, so the object may be absent or empty

max_backup_mb.description: the largest backup, in MB, a delete may make before the tool runs; default 5120

sql_allowed.description: true turns the refusal of destructive SQL off (a task with a scratch database); default false
